title: Austin Leaders Discuss Abortion Care Access
summary:
*   A press conference is scheduled to address improving access to abortion care within Austin.
*   City leaders, potentially including a majority of the City Council, are expected to attend the event.
*   This gathering is for discussion and information sharing only; no formal policy decisions or actions will be taken.
transcript:
